label: An amniote life-history database to perform comparative analyses with birds, mammals, and reptiles (Myhrvold et al. 2015), August 2015 release
governance: Ecological Society of America data paper (Myhrvold et al. 2015, Ecology 96:3109, Ecological Archives E096-269). The registered DOI is 10.1890/15-0846R.1 (Crossref: Ecology 2015 vol 96 p 3109); the variant 10.1890/15-0846.1 without the 'R' is NOT registered (doi.org handle API responseCode 100, checked 2026-10-31). The ESA archive states no licence; the Wiley figshare mirror (article 3563457, 'Full Archive', file ECOL_96_269.zip, published 2016-08-10) is CC0.
versioning: Single frozen release named by month: Amniote_Database_Aug_2015.csv (21,322 rows, 36 columns; -999 marks missing values), distributed inside ECOL_96_269.zip together with references, range-count and sparse-table files. No later versions.
known_issues: Wrong DOI in several vendored records: 10.1890/15-0846.1 does not exist; the data paper's DOI is 10.1890/15-0846R.1.

The archive directory https://esapubs.org/archive/ecol/E096/269/ answers HTTP 403 to scripts; the CSV inside the figshare zip (SHA-256 ae16377ebe8a172949c2b8c200a50c5d0c7fc04d34bd3c9704635da4a4d51f53) is the same file the esapubs-based records checksummed.
Licence is unstated at the source; 'CC0' applies only to the figshare deposit and 'CC BY 4.0' claimed by one record has no basis on either page.
Species names follow 2015 taxonomy (e.g. Neovison vison), so current binomials may not match.
rationale: Peer-reviewed ESA data paper with a resolving DOI and a frozen, checksummed archive: high authority, reduced slightly by the unstated licence and the blocked archive directory. The database compiles values from the literature and from earlier compilations covering the same taxa (it overlaps in sources with PanTHERIA and AnAge), so independence between these vendored compilations is unclear and scored 0.55. Authenticity is high for the source itself; the non-existent DOI variant is a vendoring error, handled at record level.
